⚡ BoltBeam                                                                (•ᴗ•)
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Engine                                                                       │
│ The engine is the runtime that runs the model. Each row is a family: its     │
│ root (upstream) and its forks. ↑↓ moves between families, ←→ between a       │
│ family's forks; enter picks the one in brackets.                             │
│                                                                              │
│ Only a fork found on this Mac that BoltBeam can run is picked. Engines are   │
│ looked for at start; an env var (BOLTBEAM_LLAMA_BENCH, …) overrides what was │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Choose                                                                       │
│ llama.cpp · roles not timed here                                             │
│ ▸ ● llama.cpp     ‹ upstream · [PrismML] · Ollama · Strata ›                 │
│         PrismML · found at /opt/llama.cpp-prism/build/bin/llama-bench ·      │
│         BoltBeam can't run it yet: a run with it is not wired yet            │
│     vLLM          not on this GPU type: BoltBeam runs vLLM on CUDA or AMD G… │
│     tinygrad      ‹ [upstream] · own fork ›                                  │
│         upstream · not found → get it from https://github.com/tinygrad/      │
│         tinygrad, then export BOLTBEAM_TINYGRAD_UPSTREAM=<its path>          │
│     [ Scan again ] look for engines in the usual folders                     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
